name: listbox
title: Listbox
description: A list of options, the surface a combobox and a command palette open.
use: Values or results that a script filters, groups or loads: the list of a combobox, a command palette or a multi-select. It also stands in the page by itself.

instead.when: One value from plain text options, with no script
The rows are actions, as native buttons and links
A text field opens the list and filters it

keyboard.action: Move the active option, skipping disabled ones, and scroll it into view
Move to the first or the last option
Choose the active option; in a list with aria-multiselectable="true", check or uncheck it
Move to the next option that starts with the typed letters

platform.fallback: A listbox with the popover attribute stays centered, as the browser places any popover

classes.name: listbox
classes.description: The list; a floating sheet when it has the popover attribute

classes.name: listbox-option
classes.description: An option, on an element with role="option"

classes.name: listbox-body
classes.description: Inside an option: a title stacked over a description

classes.name: listbox-description
classes.description: The muted line under an option's title, inside listbox-body

classes.name: listbox-end
classes.description: A shortcut or a hint at the end of an option

classes.name: listbox-group
classes.description: A set of options with its caption, on an element with role="group" labelled by the caption; it hides while all of its options are hidden

classes.name: listbox-label
classes.description: A quiet caption over a group of options

classes.name: listbox-separator
classes.description: A hairline between groups, running to the list's edges

classes.name: listbox-empty
classes.description: What the list says when nothing matches; it shows once every option is hidden

states.name: floating
states.description: A floating sheet placed against its anchor; use popover="manual" when a text field owns it

states.name: active
states.description: The option the arrow keys are on: a chip tone

states.name: chosen
states.description: A value that is set: a check at the end. An option with aria-checked in either state keeps room for the check

states.name: disabled
states.description: Disabled ink, and no tone under the pointer

states.name: filtered out
states.description: Set by the script that filters; the option leaves the list

properties.name: --listbox-option-radius
properties.description: Row corner; a floating list's corner is this plus the inset
